# Vorath brand rules

- Make visuals magnificent, never plain.
- Videos must never use overlay text or Ken Burns zooms.
- Evidence-grade every science claim and cite its sources.
- Keep RenalShield medical content out of the ARG.
- Respect others’ intellectual property: create homage, never copy.
- Never modify `index.html` or `HOME_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json`; both are hash-locked.
